name: 1tehfb-hub-click-through
goal: Prove Plans and All plans open stage artifacts and mockups across Hub web, Mac and iPhone, and each Scheduled item opens Chief of Staff chat with its context.

steps.title: Confirm scope, success criteria, constraints, and proof.
steps.evidence: Preview and all-plan entry points open one detail. Tracker stage artifacts and image links render there. Scheduled row opens the existing CoS overlay and sends context to the CoS route. Installed Mac/iPhone have distinct Tracker entry points. Release requires Daniel approval.

steps.title: Implement the smallest complete feature slice.
steps.evidence: Plans and All plans use the shared detail, stage artifacts and design links. Scheduled preview and agenda call the existing Chief of Staff context entry point. Installed Mac and iPhone render the same previews and use the local or already-approved device connection.

steps.title: Add or update focused automated coverage.
steps.evidence: harbor-mbp-2 red cases lacked both actionable rows at laptop and phone sizes and lacked the native work entry points. Green: combined Hub Home and contextual chat 52/52 at 95819425a1, compiled Electron and disposable Tracker 3/3 plus installed-app renderer fixtures 2/2 at 0f87bce28d. Swift Debug and Release validated the phone transport. All 42 focused index, alias and ownership guards passed at de9942b2ea. Catalogue capture and aggregate release checks are tracked separately.
